[1] Sonic the Hedgehog (Japanese: ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ , Hepburn: Sonikku za Hejjihoggu ) is a video game franchise created and produced by Sega.
[2] Sonic the Hedgehog (Japanese: ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ , Hepburn: Sonikku za Hejjihoggu ) is the title character and protagonist of the "Sonic the Hedgehog" series released by Sega, as well as numerous spin-off comics, five animated shows, and an animated OVA.
[3] Sonic Rush Adventure (ソニック ラッシュアドベンチャー , Sonikku Rasshu Adobenchā ) is a 2007 platform game in the "Sonic the Hedgehog" series for the Nintendo DS, developed by Sonic Team and Dimps and published by Sega in most regions except South Korea, where Nintendo published it.
[4] Sonic Rush (ソニック・ラッシュ , Sonikku Rasshu ) is a 2005 platform handheld video game developed by Sonic Team and Dimps for the Nintendo DS as part of Sega's "Sonic the Hedgehog" series.
